_source: Qoder apphub 详情端点 /connectors/<id>（leader 侧带鉴权抓取，本脚本只读已落盘快照）
description: Connect Bazhuayu web-scraping capabilities to your AI assistant through MCP. Search scraping templates, validate parameters, create cloud tasks, and export structured web data. Use it to turn natural-language collection requests into runnable tasks for prices, content, bidding, hiring, or public reports.
description_cn: 通过 MCP 将八爪鱼网页采集能力接入 AI 助手。可搜索采集模板、校验参数、创建云采集任务并导出结构化网页数据，把价格、内容、招投标、招聘、公开报告等自然语言采集需求转化为可执行任务。

tools.description: Use this first for scrape, crawl, extract, or collect requests. Choose one selector: `query` for semantic discovery or `id`/`slug` for exact lookup; `limit` works with `query` only (1-20). `query` returns multiple templates with `score`, `inputSchema`, and `outputSchema` when available — pick by score and Cloud-capable `executionMode`. Exact lookup returns one template with full `inputSchema` and `sourceTree` when available for `execute_task`.
tools.name: search_templates

tools.description:
Start an Octoparse cloud task from `templateName` + `parameters` (JSON object string keyed by `inputSchema[].field`). Preflight runs automatically and returns actionable input errors without creating a task when input is incomplete. Prefer a unique `taskName` for recovery via `search_tasks`.

The call waits up to 45 seconds and returns the Octoparse task id (`taskId`), `lotNo`, `collectedRows`, and status `running`, `completed`, or `stopped`. collectedRows defaults to 0; use status to distinguish a running task with no rows yet from a terminal task with no rows. If a failure result includes `taskId`, call `get_task_status(taskId)`; do not call `execute_task` again. A `progressToken` adds progress notifications. Input/Dropdown=string; MultiInput/CheckboxList=string[].
tools.name: execute_task

tools.description: Read one ClientAPI Storage page for an existing Octoparse lot. Octoparse taskId and lotNo are required. Defaults are page=1 and pageSize=20; maximum pageSize is 100. Result data is the current page Body. When enough rows are available, directAccess exposes a short signed export link plus a curlTemplate that saves the requested page to directAccess.outputFile; at 50 or more total rows, prefer curl to avoid large model context.
tools.name: export_data

tools.description: Search the current user's existing Octoparse tasks. Use this to find a taskId before export_data or start_or_stop_task. Supports pagination, keyword, status, and explicit taskIds. When UI rows are shown, respond with a concise summary instead of repeating the full list.
tools.name: search_tasks

tools.description: Start or stop an existing Octoparse task by taskId. Use action=`start` or `stop`.
tools.name: start_or_stop_task

tools.description: Check one Octoparse task by taskId. Returns its normalized unexecuted/running/completed/stopped status, current lotNo when available, and collectedRows. collectedRows is a non-negative integer that defaults to 0; use status to distinguish a running task with no rows yet from a terminal task with no rows.
tools.name: get_task_status

tools.description: Redeem a promotion, coupon, or resource code for the current user. Use this when the user wants to claim an offer/优惠 and already has the code. When responding, always use the exact text from the "displayMessage" field in the result; do not compose your own reply.
tools.name: redeem_coupon_code

tools.description: Search web content through DataCenter and return web pages, images, and videos.
tools.name: search_platform_content

tools.description: List platform codes accepted by search_platform_content.
tools.name: list_platforms

tools.description: Submit ecommerce collection tasks for reviews, product details, or keyword search. Temu productDetail requires productIds as the primary collection key and URLs are optional; use productUrlMappings when only some IDs have URLs; productUrls is optional legacy mode when every URL aligns with productIds by index. After submission, use query_collected_reviews with the returned nextStep.args (dataset and itemIds) to fetch collected records; data may be delayed.
tools.name: ecommerce_data_task

tools.description: Query collected ecommerce records by stable item IDs plus optional metadata-field filters and sorting.
tools.name: query_collected_reviews

tools.description: Describe available fields for a collected ecommerce dataset and the stable itemIds field mapping.
tools.name: describe_ecommerce_dataset
